offering_description.value: Builds and maintains roads and other paved surfaces for public agencies and private customers. Produces asphalt and aggregates for its own projects and outside customers.

primary_services.value: Road construction; asphalt paving and resurfacing; pavement maintenance; grading and site preparation; drainage installation

customer_segment.value: B2G: State transportation departments and local government agencies; B2B: Commercial developers, general contractors and other construction companies

end_markets.value: Transportation infrastructure; commercial construction; residential development

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Public and private contracts for road construction, paving and related site work; product sales: Asphalt and aggregates sold to outside construction customers

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Produces aggregates for internal construction work and outside customers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes aggregates and asphalt binder into paving mixtures; service provider: Uses construction materials and crews to build and maintain roads for public and private customers; asset operator: Operates asphalt plants, aggregate facilities and construction equipment supporting materials sales and contracting
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern and south-central United States, including Texas and Oklahoma

company_size.value: Large regional infrastructure contractor with a broad network of local operating companies, asphalt plants and aggregate facilities

specialization.value: related lines: Road construction, paving, site work, asphalt production and aggregates share materials, customers and operating infrastructure

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Public competitive bidding and negotiated or bid contracts with private customers; own locations: Asphalt plants and aggregate facilities supply construction materials to outside customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Construction, asphalt production and aggregate extraction face environmental permitting, EPA and state environmental rules, OSHA or MSHA safety requirements, and public transportation contracting standards

notes: The current geographic footprint and precise range of externally sold materials are uncertain without website content.
